versions.changelog: - No user-visible changes; documentation and skill functionality remain unchanged in this version.

Karadeo-transcribe 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Introduces detailed integration guide for agents and AI, including authentication instructions.
- Documents full MCP (Model Context Protocol) server endpoints and usage examples.
- Provides REST API reference for audio/video transcription to time-synced lyrics or subtitles in multiple formats.
- Outlines browser tool registration and capabilities via WebMCP.
- Lists discovery endpoints for skill, API, and OAuth metadata.
- States content policy restricting AI training and input usage.
